description: In any arithmetic structure satisfying induction for every subset, every element equals zero or is the successor of some element.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.full_induction_predecessor.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.FullSubsetInduction M) (x : M) :
  x = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∨
    ∃ y, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M y = x
